updates.problem: Local benchmark gain is insufficient evidence that a recursive method has improved in a transferable sense.
updates.candidate_resolution: Classify self-improvement evidence into scoped evolution, transfer-without-assurance, local improvement, meta-overfit, no improvement, blocked and cannot-check states.
updates.next_discriminator: Run prospective multi-generation experiments with distinct development, transfer and fresh/rotated assurance task planes.

updates.problem: Repeated optimizer-visible evaluation against the same holdout leaks information and can turn assurance into another development signal.
updates.candidate_resolution: Track preregistered optimizer-visible exposure limits; exhausted assurance can document transfer but cannot repeatedly mint strong evolution evidence.
updates.next_discriminator: Compare repeated fixed-holdout evolution against rotated/fresh assurance under matched evolution budgets.

updates.problem: Absorbing useful external methods should not imply one monolithic globally dominant workflow or erase context-specific strengths.
updates.candidate_resolution: Maintain non-dominated validated operators per atomic fiber and context; assimilation can replace, complement, deduplicate or retain a parallel local view.
updates.next_discriminator: Freeze Pareto/frontier known-answer worlds before implementing runtime routing or frontier maintenance.

updates.new_evidence: SkillFoundry and ADAS make generic skill/agent recombination prior art; top-tier value now depends on testing authority-preserving contextual assimilation against uncontrolled aggregation and static curation.

EvoAgentBench, SkillFoundry, ADAS and Red Queen Gödel Machine narrow the self-evolution novelty boundary; independent review must test the integrated dual-source governed evolution claim, not the broad phrase self-evolving agent.

saturation.reason: The self-evolution claim was materially decomposed into local gain, transfer and assurance, while external assimilation opened a context-indexed capability-frontier residual.
